result.instructions: Tools for Booqable, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Booqable data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run booqable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run booqable_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run booqable_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. booqable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: booqable_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the Booqable account this token belongs to — name, currency, default timezone, address. A cheap way to confirm the slug and token work. Booqable: GET /api/4/companies/current.

tools.name: booqable_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List rental orders. Filter by free-text search (order number, customer name/email/address, tags, custom fields), status, payment status, customer, or rental-period range. Booqable: GET /api/4/orders.

q.description: Search: order number (exact), customer name, e-mail, address, tags, custom field values.

status.description: Only orders with this simplified status.

payment_status.description: Only orders with this payment status.

customer_id.description: Only orders for this customer id.

starts_at_gte.description: Rental starts at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

starts_at_lte.description: Rental starts at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_gte.description: Rental ends at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_lte.description: Rental ends at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. customer,start_location,stop_location.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch one order with its totals, deposit and payment state, sideloading the customer and order lines by default (override with include, e.g. customer,lines,payments,documents,notes). Booqable: GET /api/4/orders/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally searched by name/email or filtered by email, tag or archived state. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers.

email.description: Only the customer with exactly this email.

archived.description: true = only archived, false = only active.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. properties.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer with order count, revenue and balance due, sideloading their properties (addresses, phone, custom fields) by default. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. properties,tax_region.

tools.name: booqable_list_product_groups
tools.title: List product groups
tools.description: List product groups — the catalogue entries (name, SKU, product type, tracking type, pricing). A group holds one or more bookable products (variations). Booqable: GET /api/4/product_groups.

archived.description: true = only archived, false = only active.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. products,photo.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List bookable products (the variations inside product groups). Use a product id for availability checks and booking. Booqable: GET /api/4/products.

product_group_id.description: Only products in this product group.

archived.description: true = only archived, false = only active.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. product_group,photo.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_check_inventory_availability
tools.title: Check inventory availability
tools.description: How many units of one or more products can be booked for an exact period at a location. Returns `available` and `plannable` (plannable can exceed available when shortage is allowed). Get location ids from booqable_list_locations. Booqable: GET /api/4/inventory_availabilities.

from.description: Period start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

till.description: Period end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

tools.name: booqable_get_availability_calendar
tools.title: Get a product's availability calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability for one product over a month: status (available/partial/unavailable) and bookable quantity per day. Booqable: GET /api/4/availabilities with subject_type=item.

quantity.description: Units needed; sets the threshold for available vs partial.

tools.name: booqable_list_plannings
tools.title: List plannings
tools.description: List plannings — which product is booked on which order, how many, when, and how many are started (out) or stopped (returned). Filter by order, product, or reservation window. Booqable: GET /api/4/plannings.

product_id.description: Only plannings for this product or bundle (item_id).

starts_at_gte.description: Planned start at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

starts_at_lte.description: Planned start at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_gte.description: Planned end at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_lte.description: Planned end at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. item,order,order.customer.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List invoices, quotes and contracts, with totals and payment status. Filter by type, order, customer or status. Booqable: GET /api/4/documents.

status.description: Only documents in this status (values depend on document type).

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. customer,order.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments (charges, authorizations and refunds) with amount, deposit, currency, provider and status. Filter by order, customer or payment type. Read only — this server never moves money. Booqable: GET /api/4/payments.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. order,payment_method.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

tools.name: booqable_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List pickup/return locations (warehouses, stores) with address and pickup/delivery capability. Location ids are needed for availability checks and orders. Booqable: GET /api/4/locations.

archived.description: true = only archived, false = only active.

tools.name: booqable_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List internal notes attached to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: GET /api/4/notes.

owner_id.description: The id of the record the notes are about.

tools.name: booqable_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer. Booqable: POST /api/4/customers.

discount_percentage.description: Default discount % applied to this customer's new orders.

email_marketing_consented.description: Whether the customer consented to email marketing.

tools.name: booqable_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer's name, email, legal type, tags, default discount or marketing consent. Only the fields you pass change. Booqable: PUT /api/4/customers/{id}.

discount_percentage.description: Default discount % applied to this customer's new orders.

email_marketing_consented.description: Whether the customer consented to email marketing.

tools.name: booqable_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create an EMPTY order for a rental period (status new or draft). Then add products with booqable_book_product and reserve it with booqable_transition_order_status. Locations default to the first active location. Booqable: POST /api/4/orders.

starts_at.description: Rental start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

stops_at.description: Rental end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

customer_id.description: The customer this order is for.

status.description: Initial status. Default new (visible only to its creator); draft is visible but reserves nothing.

tools.name: booqable_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: Change an order's rental period, customer, locations or tags. Moving dates can cause a shortage: the call then fails with the shortage details, and a shortage *warning* can be accepted by retrying with confirm_shortage: true. Booqable: PUT /api/4/orders/{id}.

starts_at.description: New rental start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

stops_at.description: New rental end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

customer_id.description: Assign this customer (re-applies their discount, deposit and tax region).

confirm_shortage.description: true to proceed despite a shortage warning.

tools.name: booqable_book_product
tools.title: Book a product on an order
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to an order, allocating inventory (creates a planning and a line). By default adds to an existing planning for the same product if there is one. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_fulfillments with a book_product action.

mode.description: infer_planning (default): reuse the product's planning if any; create_new: always a new line; update_existing: add to planning_id.

confirm_shortage.description: true to accept a shortage warning when booking on a reserved or started order.

annotations.title: Book a product on an order

tools.name: booqable_transition_order_status
tools.title: Change an order's status
tools.description: Move an order between statuses: new→draft, draft→reserved (reserves the items and assigns an order number), stopped→archived, or back to an earlier status with revert: true. Canceling is deliberately NOT offered (Booqable cannot un-cancel). started/stopped are reached by picking up/returning items, so they are only valid here with revert: true. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_status_transitions.

transition_from.description: The order's CURRENT status (Booqable checks it).

revert.description: true when going back to an earlier status (required for started/stopped).

confirm_shortage.description: true to accept a shortage warning when reserving.

tools.name: booqable_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Attach an internal note to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: POST /api/4/notes.

owner_id.description: The id of the record the note is about.
